A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TPO research work, with 23 readable pages including Appendices A-D. Text and visual comparisons establish that the equations, tables, figures and appendices are available for reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original TPO evaluations on mathematical reasoning, coding and reasoning benchmarks, together with ablations, sensitivity analyses and statistical tests.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark results and appendix experiments, including the repeated-run evaluation of Adaptive Step Reward in Appendix C.4.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same Preference List Ranking objective, lambda weights and Adaptive Step Reward mechanism. No algorithm, model component or training objective changes.

E1.justification: The training data and evaluation coverage remain identical: MATH, SVAMP, ASDiv, GSM-Plus, HumanEval, MBPP, BBH and MMLU. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same SFT, DPO, DeepSeekMath-7B-RL and GPT baselines. Appendix C.2 also retains both DPO* and DPO+ in Table 5.

E3.justification: The model configurations, ten trajectories per training problem, one-epoch training budget, evaluation prompts and pass@1 metric are unchanged. The supplementary experiments retain their original settings.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same component ablations, reward-distribution and preference-list-size analyses, ranking-loss comparisons, two case studies and beta sensitivity experiments in Section 4 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Appendix C.4 retains the reported 20 independent experiments for TPO and its Adaptive Step Reward ablation. Table 7 preserves the same means, standard errors, independent t-tests and significance reporting.

E6.justification: All result entries and reported findings are retained in the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 gives the same TPO mathematics averages of 54.43 for Qwen2-7B-Instruct and 73.36 for DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions and equations remain identical, including the ranking objective, lambda weighting, equal-length-step assumption and adaptive reward-margin formulation. No proof or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about learning from preference trees, outperforming DPO on in-distribution tasks and potential out-of-distribution generalization.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including catastrophic forgetting as an explanation for HumanEval declines, imbalanced reward distributions, semantic similarity versus token overlap, and the beta trade-off.

D1.justification: The repository link, implementation libraries, hardware, hyperparameters, data-generation instructions and Appendix B prompts are unchanged. No technical or reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography and research positioning remain identical, including Appendix D's discussion of S-DPO, Rose-DPO and ODPO and their objectives in Table 9.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv annotation changes from v2 dated 13 March 2025 to v3 dated 24 October 2025. The body wording, terminology, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1, 2 and 4 receive small scaling and spacing adjustments. Reflow moves the beginning of the Ablation Studies paragraph from page 8 to page 9, keeping it together below Table 3; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the scientific and explanatory content, including all appendix evidence and limitations. The small table-formatting adjustments, paragraph reflow and updated version annotation produce no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
